PEFNet.paper: F. Jiang, T. Li, X. Lv, H. Rui, and D. Jin, Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Path Loss Estimation by Solving Electromagnetic Integral Equations, IEEE Transactions on Wireless Communications, vol. 23, no. 10, pp. 15380-15393, 2024
PEFNet.license: not applicable; no author code or weights are copied
PEFNet.local_use: independent paper-inspired VIE-regularized U-Net adaptation; stable-v2 uses GroupNorm, BF16 only for the knowledge U-Net, FP32 refinement, and a fixed warm-up schedule; must be reported as PEFNet-inspired, not official or faithful PEFNet reproduction
PEFNet.status: carrier frequency, metric grid scale, conductivity, complex fields, transmit power, and PNG-to-dB mapping are unavailable in the local dataset; dimensionless effective-medium and numerical-stability assumptions are recorded in configs/pefnet_inspired_adapted.yaml and docs/PEFNET_ADAPTATION.md
